card.name: Period ending an academic citation
card.fires_on: The period (or space) that closes a bibliographic citation entry, right after pages, dates or institution names, just before the next author list or a new entry. Seen in RePEc/IDEAS and PhilPapers listings.

modes.label: Period after citation
modes.description: Full stop closing a journal or working-paper reference, before the next author names.
modes.example: Journal of Population Economics, Springer, vol. 24(2), pages 681-700, April<<. >>- Deborah Wilson & Simon Burgess & Adam

modes.label: Space after repository note
modes.description: Space ending a catalog line before a list of authors.
